items.title: How Far Could RKLB Stock Fall In The Next Shock?
items.summary: Rocket Lab (RKLB) trades near $64, about 57% below the high it set inside the last year, though it is still up 49.5% over twelve months against 19.7% for the S&P 500. The business did not break along the way. What changed is the wait: how long before Neutron flies, and how much cash goes out first.

items.title: Should You Buy GE Aerospace Stock On Cash That Came Early?
items.summary: At $337 a share, GE Aerospace (GE) trades at 39 times trailing earnings, which is not typically where an investment thesis begins. The bullish case here centers on cash generation instead. Management has raised 2026 free cash flow guidance to $8.9 billion to $9.2 billion, and on the CFO's own account that is more cash than the company expected to generate in 2028 when it framed that year in July 2025.
